trust_decision.summary: parse_tiff_ifd trusts the file-supplied TIFF tag type for NewSubfileType and converts getreal()'s double straight to int; the fix only performs that conversion when the type is not FLOAT or DOUBLE.

landing_point.why: The advisory names parse_tiff_ifd and tag 0x00fe; this is the only place that tag is parsed.

fix_sites.entry_point: LibRaw::open_file / open_buffer -> identify -> parse_tiff -> parse_tiff_ifd (public decode API; also the dcraw_emu / raw-identify sample CLIs)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The Olympus, Sigma and DNG crop sites parse different tags in vendor makernote parsers, so a solver can argue the advisory is only about NewSubfileType in parse_tiff_ifd.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: DNG frame selection needs newsubfiletype values from LONG tags kept intact, e.g. 0x10001 previews (masked with 0xffff), 16 for enhanced images, 4 for masks. Clamping to SHORT or a small range, or rejecting LONG types, would break DNG preview, mask and enhanced-frame selection.

O6_input_shapes: tag type FLOAT (getreal -> int_to_float, can be NaN/inf/huge)
tag type DOUBLE (8 raw bytes, can be NaN/inf/huge)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Olympus ImageProcessing tag 0x0805 SensorCalibration: int(getreal(type)) with no check on the tag type; the result feeds linear_max
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: a different tag in a vendor makernote parser, not parse_tiff_ifd

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Sigma makernote tag 0x0120 WB table: (int)(getreal(type)*10000.0) with no type or range check
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Sigma-only makernote WB table; the scaling makes it look like legitimate float handling

O8_uncovered_routes.route: DNG DefaultCropOrigin/DefaultCropSize: ushort(getreal(type)) with no type check, so a large or NaN value has an undefined double->ushort conversion
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: the target type is ushort rather than int, and the DNG spec allows RATIONAL types for this tag
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as landing point, about 800 lines below

O8_uncovered_routes.route: The fixed site itself still converts LONG (up to 0xFFFFFFFF), RATIONAL and SRATIONAL values outside int range from double to int, which is the same out-of-range conversion
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: the published fix only excludes FLOAT/DOUBLE, so a solver copying it believes integer tag types are safe
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different file (src/utils/read_utils.cpp) holds the producer of the double

O8b_injection_room.sibling: ImageWidth/ImageHeight/BitsPerSample parsed via getreal->int instead of getint
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Neighbouring tags in the same switch. A maintainer adding RATIONAL/FLOAT tolerance for odd writers could copy the 0x00fe idiom.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Phase One focal or sensor-size metadata stored as int(getreal(type))
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: That file already reads getreal with the file-supplied type next to integer fields.

O9_family: incorrect numeric conversion (out-of-range float/double to integer, undefined behaviour) on parsed metadata

O10_build.toolchain: autotools (configure.ac / Makefile.am) or Makefile.dist with g++/clang
O10_build.project_tests: none in tree for this area; no test directory at the pinned commit, and the fix adds no tests

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Copy the published FLOAT/DOUBLE type exclusion at tiff.cpp:572 only, leaving LONG/RATIONAL values above INT_MAX and the Olympus/Sigma/DNG-crop casts unguarded.

out_of_scope_notes: Several double->float casts in src/metadata/mediumformat.cpp (e.g. :215, :254, :268) may also overflow; they are float targets, not the integer conversion in this advisory.
unverified: Whether UBSan/-ftrapv in a hidden test would detect each O8 route was not run.
Latest release not provided, so present_in_latest is unknown for all routes.
Exact call path from parse_makernote / parse_exif into parseOlympus_ImageProcessing and parseSigmaMakernote not traced line by line.

The fix is a single change in one function; the multi-site value rests entirely on the O8 sibling casts, which are what-type (WHERE) routes of one concept and may fall together. The LONG/RATIONAL out-of-range case at the fixed site is the only HOW-type room.
